title: slot ls
description: List every slot (worktree) with its status (free/merged = reusable; waiting-merge/wip/dirty/closed-pr/locked/stale/unknown = busy), tracker issue, associated PR(s), branch, and live/dead worker. Use this to find a reusable slot before handing off work.

free.description: print only the labels of reusable slots, space-separated

watch.description: redraw the table on an interval until Ctrl-C (alias: --follow)

follow.description: alias for --watch (one word works across ls/ps/logs)
